Winery.Description: Choose from Building or Shed. Building adds the Winery as a new custom building. Shed adds it as a shed-type building for Market Town compatibility but it will NOT be compatible with other custom shed interiors. Defaults to Building.

InteriorStyle.Description: Choose if you would like the interior of the building to be pre-furnished with movable furniture or empty. Defaults to Furnished. NOTE: you must have H&W Winery Furniture pack installed in order for the furniture to spawn in.
